Study Kit.name: Study Kit
Study Kit.description:
✏️ You carry a student's desk in a bag.

⚖️ All of it is legal and ordinary.
📖 The textbooks match your course, or whatever you last studied.
⚠️ Your Quirk notebook is private: if lost, it can embarrass you and help a villain.
☕ The coffee is gone once drunk.

🎒 Starts with: Course textbooks, Quirk analysis notebook, Omamori charm, Canned coffee ×3
Study Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: The character owns the term's textbooks and lecture notes, a notebook for recording and sketching the Quirks they observe, a shrine charm bought for success in exams and a few cans of vending-machine coffee. All of it is legal and ordinary. For a student the textbooks match their course; for anyone else they are the books of whatever they last studied. The notebook is private and sensitive: notes on other people's Quirks can embarrass the writer and help a villain if it is lost. The coffee is gone once drunk.
